text.text_excerpt: OMGGGGGG!!!!!! MUST HAVE. I can't even form sentences just thinking about this... or at least without salivating. I took my parents who were in town for the week to the arts market and I told them politely that they HAD to try these. Yes, I took them all over town for the best meals and I insisted on a box of fries. My dad got some with cheese and olive salad, I can't quite remember exactly... anyways, he actually put these fries in his TOP 5 of his favorite meals in New Orleans hahaha!! Seriously. Last weekend I had the Rosemary, Parmesan, & Garlic fries and my roommate had the Pimento cheese, Thyme and Garlic ones. They were both ridiculously good. Like, really really ridiculously good ...

LOVE LOVE LOVE the Fry Bar. They are another one of the mobile foods stands quickly popping up all over the city. They specialize in Fries, YUMMY Gourmet fries! Here are some examples of the "flavors" they have put out Basil, Feta Salad, & Garlic Oregano, Provolone, Olive Salad, & Garlic Thyme, Goat Cheese, & Garlic fries with truffle oil Rosemary, Parm, & Garlic fries w/ brisket Fried Basil, aged Provolone & garlic Queso Fresco, Cilantro & chili Powder Feta Oregano & lemon Zatarain's, Garlic & green onion They also do sauces like Rosemary and red pepper ketchup, chili aioli, mustard mayo and something they call guacamoleo (haven't tried that one because I am not a fan of guacamole) Yeah ...

We tried the Garlic, Rosemary, Parmesan fries today at the Arts Market. So good! The rosemary kind of disappeared to the bottom, but I enjoyed the garlic & parm throughout the container of fries. Not the healthiest snack, but a delicious treat. My daughter requested some "normal ketchup" but she was content eating them plain... I enjoyed the fancy ketchup :)
